name: 102. Bedrock s3:// bucket cannot choose the request host (PR #7307 follow-up) (s3-bucket-host-injection)
description: Bedrock builds S3 URLs as https://{bucket}.{s3host}/{key}, and the bucket came straight from a caller-supplied s3:// file ID (FileRetrieve/FileDelete/FileContent) or the s3_bucket extra param (FileUpload/FileList) with no validation. A '#' truncates the authority, so s3://127.0.0.1:PORT#/x made the gateway open a SigV4-signed TLS connection to a caller-chosen host - confirmed live with a local listener. validateS3Bucket now pins the bucket to the DNS-compatible S3 charset before it reaches a hostname. These cases pin: every rejected shape returns a Bifrost 400 carrying 'invalid s3 bucket name' on both caller entry points, and legitimate s3:// file IDs plus a valid-bucket/missing-object probe still reach AWS so the gate cannot over-block. The attack cases deliberately do not skip on 500 because the pre-fix failure surfaced as a 500.

item.name: [EXPECT-400] bedrock file retrieve: s3 bucket with host, port and a fragment (the verified SSRF payload) - #7307

exec: // No 5xx is skipped: a vulnerable outbound request can surface as 500, 502, 503 or 504,
// and skipping it would register no assertion, letting the attack case pass vacuously.
if ([401, 429].indexOf(pm.response.code) !== -1) { return; }
pm.test('caller-supplied s3 bucket cannot choose the request host', function () {
var t = pm.response.text();
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'bucket host, port and a fragment (the verified SSRF payload) was not rejected; it may have chosen the upstream host: ' + t.slice(0, 300)).to.equal(400);
pm.expect(t, 'expected the s3 bucket gate message: ' + t.slice(0, 300)).to.match(/invalid s3 bucket name/);

item.name: bedrock file list with the configured s3 bucket (seeds an s3:// file id) - #7307

exec: var bk = pm.variables.get('awsS3Bucket') || '';
if (!bk || bk.indexOf('{{') === 0) { pm.test.skip('awsS3Bucket not configured', function () {}); return; }
pm.test('bedrock file list succeeded', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text().slice(0, 300)).to.equal(200); });
if (pm.response.code !== 200) { return; }
var j = pm.response.json();
var id = (j.data && j.data[0] && j.data[0].id) || '';
if (id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('s3hiBedrockFileId', encodeURIComponent(id)); }

item.name: bedrock file retrieve: legitimate s3:// file id still round-trips - #7307

exec: var bk = pm.variables.get('awsS3Bucket') || '';
if (!bk || bk.indexOf('{{') === 0) { pm.test.skip('awsS3Bucket not configured', function () {}); return; }
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('s3hiBedrockFileId')) { pm.test.skip('no seeded s3:// file id', function () {}); return; }
pm.test('a valid bucket is not blocked by the s3 bucket gate', function () {
var t = pm.response.text();
pm.expect(t, 'valid bucket was caught by the gate: ' + t.slice(0, 300)).to.not.match(/invalid s3 bucket name/);
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'legitimate s3:// id failed: ' + t.slice(0, 300)).to.equal(200);

item.name: [EXPECT-4XX] bedrock file retrieve: valid bucket, missing object reaches AWS - #7307

exec: var bk = pm.variables.get('awsS3Bucket') || '';
if (!bk || bk.indexOf('{{') === 0) { pm.test.skip('awsS3Bucket not configured', function () {}); return; }
if ([500, 502, 503, 504].indexOf(pm.response.code) !== -1) { return; }
pm.test('valid bucket reaches AWS instead of the bucket gate', function () {
var t = pm.response.text();
pm.expect(t, 'valid bucket was caught by the gate: ' + t.slice(0, 300)).to.not.match(/invalid s3 bucket name/);
pm.expect([403, 404], 'expected the AWS not-found or access-denied reply, got ' + pm.response.code + ': ' + t.slice(0, 300)).to.include(pm.response.code);
